$comment: SSOT for the herdr binary this repository has MEASURED against. Nothing else may carry a version or a digest: the CI installer, the sandbox gate's boundary check and the launch-rail document all read or cite this file. Re-measuring a new herdr means measuring it FIRST — fetched by digest and verified before it is made executable, then run against a private sandbox server (at least version, status-client protocol and integration rows) — then editing this file and repairing the measured sentences in docs/herdr-launch-rail.md in the same commit; miss one and the gate fails on version mismatch, which is the point. A private baseline is not the full gate: check-herdr-sandbox at a new pin is certified by its exact-SHA CI run unless it was also run locally, and an asset is recorded `executed` only with a receipt bound to this version and its full digest (check-herdr-supply HSUP-EXECUTION-RECEIPT-BOUND).

integrity.note: GitHub signs that these digests are this tag's assets. It is NOT a SLSA build provenance authored by herdr and NOT a reproducible-build claim. Corroborate with `gh api repos/herdrdev/herdr/attestations/sha256:<digest>`; `gh attestation verify` 2.97.0 cannot close this predicate and must not be depended on.
